$comment: 4 fixed quiz->rec personas per design Sec.14.3. Answer option keys are the documented Sec.7.1/Sec.7.2 vocabulary; catalyst vocab per 00243 loadings seed: new_home | moving | milestone | refresh | just_looking. 'expected' fields are directional placeholders until the week-4 designer calibration.

personas.name: The Hendersons
personas.description: Young family in a new build — warm, calm, durable; willing to buy once and keep it.

expected.notes: Kids/pets durability is a near-hard filter (Q2 family); patina affinity positive via weathered_oak (+0.4).

personas.name: Marcus
personas.description: Downtown loft, hosts often, undecided on spend — cool-toned, editorial, low clutter. A lead-signal persona (investment = discuss).

expected.notes: Null budget range must NOT become a price filter; metal affinity ~0.9.

personas.name: Priya & Sam
personas.description: First real furniture budget after years of hand-me-downs — classic, comfortable, built to be lived on.

expected.notes: Zero budget violations is the hard bar here; aged_leather carries patina affinity (+0.5).

personas.name: Dana
personas.description: Collector's eye — layered, story-driven rooms; buys single statement pieces for keeps.

expected.notes: The '>=1 wouldn't-have-thought-of-it' exploration bar is most testable on this persona.
